description: PostGrid provides APIs and tools for print-and-mail automation and address verification. Its products let businesses verify, standardize, and autocomplete addresses and programmatically send physical mail such as letters, postcards, and cheques.
summary: PostGrid exposes one documented REST API at `https://api.postgrid.com`, described by an OpenAPI document on `guides.postgrid.com`, and authenticated with an `x-api-key` header; no GraphQL, MCP server, or standalone CLI was documented on this domain.
